build_bundle.py restricts --extra artifacts to src/models/scripts/evaluation. Research fetchers under evaluation/ are still IN the allowlist: they must be excluded by not passing them as --extra, or by widening the check so the submission ZIP cannot carry ASL Citizen download code. ZIP ships only src/main.py + requirements + README + explicit --extra + model/labels/results + generated Dockerfile.

evaluation/device/robustness.py: shutil.rmtree(workdir) is NOT in a try/finally. A decode/write failure mid-loop leaves corrupted derivative clips in <output-dir>/work/. Reproduced: paired_evaluate on an unreadable clip raises ValueError and the work dir remains. HANDOFF: wrap loop in try/finally (owned by Abhijeet's eval code).

evaluation/device/run_manifest.py:read_manifest resolves relative clip paths from the manifest dir but allows '../' and absolute paths pointing anywhere on disk (no containment check). Low risk (local evaluator, operator-supplied manifest) but a crafted manifest can pull clips from outside the dataset dir. Reproduced: 'c1,../outside.mp4' is accepted. HANDOFF: add containment check or document it as a deliberate operator capability.

evaluation/device/run_manifest.py writes platform.node() as 'device_model' plus absolute resolved paths for every artifact into benchmark.json. If that file is pasted into results/notes or submitted, it discloses the operator's hostname and local paths. HANDOFF: use a generic device label and repo-relative paths for any evidence that leaves the machine.

app/offline_demo.py: NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False) temp becomes unlink(missing_ok=True) in finally -> file deleted on success AND on predictor exception (verified; the only leak is SIGKILL/machine crash, which no user-space code can clean). Frames remain in RAM (deque + list copy) and are freed on submit/clear but not explicitly scrubbed. Wording 'no footage retained' would be more honest as 'no footage is kept on disk after each capture; frames are held in memory only during inference'. The on-disk claim holds.

Temp clips are created in the shared system temp dir with a predictable prefix 'echogesture-capture-*.mp4' (tempfile gives 0600 + O_EXCL, so predictable-name attack is blocked, but the file is still world-listable by name in /tmp and same-user processes can open it). Prefer a private subdir (tempfile.mkdtemp, 0700) or TMPDIR with restricted permissions for any release build. HANDOFF if demo is reworked.

README.md:167-172 states 'Our code and harnesses: MIT' but there is no LICENSE text to bind that statement, and no per-asset licence/attribution file for hand_landmarker.task (MediaPipe, Apache-2.0) or the S3D weights. Do not label the release 'MIT' without adding the licence text.

models/ contains 4 .tflite + hand_landmarker.task + 3 .json. Trained Dev landmark classifier (fp16/int8, ASL Citizen-derived) carries the ASL Citizen research-licence context: evaluation, not redistribution, of the dataset is permitted but weights trained on it must not be over-claimed as freely licensable or commercially shippable. Verify Organizer + licence review before shipping any trained weight; match the model's vocab (landmark_ labels) to the packaged label file. hand_landmarker.task is a Google MediaPipe asset (Apache-2.0 per MediaPipe terms; verify current terms and add attribution) - checked-in blob must carry its provenance. S3D ptq/qat weights: README attributes MIT to Kimpinde & Olukanmi (Algorithms 2026); confirm the licence text ships with the weights and that WLASL C-UDA restrictions do not reattach - the weights were trained on WLASL, which README itself says cannot be shipped commercially.

evaluation/asl_citizen_predictions.csv (1706 lines, participant IDs P15-style) is tracked in Git. As derived evaluation output it is low-risk, but participant IDs are personal-adjacent metadata: confirm ASL Citizen terms allow redistribution of per-participant result rows, or strip participant IDs before submission. Raw clips correctly stay outside Git (fetch_*.py write to operator-chosen output dirs); there is no .gitignore in this audit copy - confirm the original retains *.mp4/.scratch exclusions.
